lines.1: 「Finally awake? You sure put me through it.」
lines.3: A little longer before her main power comes on.
lines.5: And now her main power finally switches on.
lines.8: 「Okay, then meet me in twenty minutes. You get thirty seconds' leeway.」
lines.9: 「I know, I know. Leave it to me.」
lines.10: After waking Crab, I head back home for now.
lines.11: I feel a little more refreshed.
lines.12: I bite into one of the familiar rice balls Otome put so much care into making.
lines.14: 「A wild bear cub was lured into a private home by food, but has safely been returned to the mountains.」
lines.15: 「A rumor is spreading among local residents that this cub may be the offspring of the bear that previously came down from the mountains after being lured by food.」
lines.17: I pick up the other rice ball and bring it to my mouth.
lines.19: This one is filled with pickled daikon too.
